d8b40a53267c6928484dc110a15cb9522762baa8.description: Join us for compelling, challenging, and honest discussions, guided by our 2026 Festival theme: Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action. The four-day programme will be guided by the theme Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action., which comes from Sanskrit philosophy and emphasises the harmony between Citta (mind), Rasa (heart), and Karsa (action). It invites reflection on how thought, feeling, and action can exist in harmony. We explore the forces that shape us to find a perfect balance of awareness, empathy, and action. From the technological to the spiritual, the personal, and the environmental, we trace the cycles of our existence, not just to understand where we have been, but to guide humanity toward where we must go: a future defined by compassionate response. We are also thrilled to reveal this year’s artwork by Balinese artist Wayan Aris Sarmanta, a young talent whose work originates from his hometown’s Batuan painting style. There are more than over 100 events taking place across Ubud, featuring over 150 of Indonesia's and the region's most exciting authors, actors, journalists, poets, and thinkers. Tickets: https://www.ubudwritersfestival.com/tickets

fe12fce99cffaa563aeb7c429ca50c9753f09964.description: Dear Earthlings, Rituals matter. They set the tone, stir the mood, and give us a very good excuse to get together. And for our next one, we’re taking things a little further… On Saturday, 28th November alongside KAIS EYE MEDIA, RITUAL starts on the beach before moving into The Sunset Mansion, an ocean-facing villa, somewhere between a sunset gathering, a house party and the kind of night that accidentally turns into breakfast. And this time, we’re bringing a very special guest. MICHAEL MAYER (Kompakt) / DE Co-founder of the legendary German label Kompakt, Michael Mayer has spent more than three decades shaping the more curious, emotional and wonderfully unpredictable corners of electronic music. Producer, selector, label boss, obsessive music digger and, above all, a truly exceptional DJ. From his iconic Immer mixes to Fabric, DJ-Kicks and countless dancefloors around the world, Michael has built a career around one simple idea we happen to agree with: Great music. Great people. The rest usually takes care of itself. And he won’t be alone… ANSTASCIA Formerly one half of BLOND:ISH and a serious force behind the decks. LUNAR DISCO Our French-Australian troublemakers, with releases on Crosstown Rebels, Defected and beyond. GADO GADO The minds behind La Piscine Électronique and plenty of other questionable good ideas. ANDY CHUNES PNNY crew representative and certified record selector. JULIA TIPSY Grooves, grooves and probably a few more grooves. SoFi Flying the Swiss flag and bringing a little Alpine mischief to the tropics. And perhaps a few surprises along the way… We start early. We finish late. Possibly very early and for breakfast. Sunset. DJs. Food. Drinks. Ocean. Bare feet strongly encouraged. Good behaviour entirely optional. TICKETS 100 FREE GUESTLISTS will be released through our WhatsApp group. First come, first served — earthlings move fast. ff31c59ecabafef61427e5bc23b004a209628eb3.description: THE MIDNIGHT FIRE: NEW YEAR’S EVE DINNER & CELEBRATION AT EMBERS UBUD A Five-Course Mediterranean-Inspired New Year’s Eve Dinner & Celebration Welcome the new year with an unforgettable New Year’s Eve dinner in Ubud at Embers Mediterranean Restaurant. The Midnight Fire brings this philosophy to the festive season with a five-course dinner created especially for New Year’s Eve. Choose between our Land & Sea or Vegetarian menu, elevate the experience with a wine pairing, and begin the evening with a festive cocktail during our early-evening cocktail service. Then, as the night deepens, let live music carry you toward midnight and into the first moments of 2027. A MEDITERRANEAN NEW YEAR’S EVE IN UBUD Whether you are celebrating with your partner, gathering with friends, or sharing the occasion with family, The Midnight Fire offers a relaxed yet festive way to welcome the new year. Expect generous flavors, thoughtful craftsmanship, fire-kissed dishes, handcrafted drinks, live music, and an atmosphere designed for lingering long after dinner is finished. This is New Year’s Eve in Ubud, the Embers way — warm, flavorful, and made for memorable moments. SATOSHI’s Brand Chef Igor Grishechkin and Kindling’s Chef Vallian Gunawan will work together to deliver a perfect blend of Italian tradition and Japanese precision, with Asian flavours through French culinary techniques. While Chef Igor Grishechkin brings his interpretation of Itameshi, Chef Vallian Gunawan will showcase his expertise, honed during his years working for distinguished establishments such as L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon, Saint Pierre, Odette in Singapore, and Seasons Restaurant in Hong Kong. 31bb32c3326d503959002c2648360bd0a08a5c3f.name: Recovr Pals Club: Halloween Morning Edition
31bb32c3326d503959002c2648360bd0a08a5c3f.description: This Halloween, start the spookiest time of the year a bit differently with a morning of wellness and active fun. Introducing Recovr Pals Club: Halloween Morning Edition! A community-driven event organised through a collaboration between Recovr Physio , a physiotherapy-focused health and wellness provider, and Old Pals , a neighbourhood eatery, the inaugural event brings together a morning of movement, recovery, nutrition, and community. Taking place on Saturday, 31 October 2026 , the event is designed for Bali’s active community and families, with a programme featuring a 5K Fun Run, a friendly Padel match, breathwork, yoga and mat Pilates. For IDR 400,000 per person , participants can choose two of the listed activities . f735e93755350bd0b04c6feba558f21e337d2a63.name: Sunday Brunch Series: W Bali – Seminyak x The Sayan House
f735e93755350bd0b04c6feba558f21e337d2a63.description: On 25 October 2026, Starfish Bloo at W Bali – Seminyak welcomes The Sayan House from Ubud for a special edition of its signature Sunday Brunch. Bringing together Japanese precision and Latin American flair, the collaboration introduces the restaurant’s distinctive fusion cuisine to a beachfront dining experience in Seminyak. Led by Kitchen Manager Chef Dipa Mahayana , The Sayan House combines the delicate flavours of Japanese cuisine with the bold character of South American cooking. For this special brunch, held from 12 PM to 3.30 PM , a dedicated buffet station will showcase a selection of the restaurant’s signature creations, offering guests a taste of its inventive approach to cross-cultural dining. Highlights include Ceviche del Mar , featuring fresh fish with Salsa Veracruz, green Tabasco, ohba leaf, lime and shiso oil. Tokyo Curry pairs beef curry sauce and rice with egg, butter and chimichurri, while Los De Sashimi combines citrus-marinated prawns, salmon and tuna with fresh vegetables and wasabi dressing.

741acc9c231d8e22d33b4e487130cafc64bba5a3.name: Tropical Reverie: A Two-Day Exclusive Afternoon Tea by Chef Julien Perrinet
741acc9c231d8e22d33b4e487130cafc64bba5a3.description: On 22 and 23 October 2026, Andaz Bali, by Hyatt, welcomes the Executive Pastry Chef Asia Pacific at Park Hyatt Tokyo, Chef Julien Perrinet, for Tropical Reverie, an exclusive two-day afternoon tea experience. Famous for his work across the Asia-Pacific, Chef Julien Perrinet will bring his pastry expertise from Tokyo all the way to Bali for this special culinary collaboration. Held at Village Square, Andaz Bali , by Hyatt, Chef Julien’s exceptional approach to pastry, centred around fruit, will prove that this experience is more than just a traditional afternoon tea. He will showcase a selection of desserts and savoury bites created specifically for the two-day Tropical Reverie experience at Andaz Bali. With a village-inspired and laid-back setting, the collaboration offers guests the opportunity to experience firsthand the combination of meticulous technique with premium fruit flavours from Les Vergers Boiron for only two days .

f7ba7ec91e239d52a044c10ebc3385f50d2db2dc.name: Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF) 2026
f7ba7ec91e239d52a044c10ebc3385f50d2db2dc.description: Southeast Asia’s biggest literary event, Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF), returns this 22 to 25 October with a powerful programme of over a hundred separate events. For its 23rd year, authors, thinkers, journalists, poets and more will descend upon Ubud for a week of insight and intrigue. The theme this year is ‘Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action.’, which will guide UWRF’s main programme’s many curated conversations and panels. 150 of the region’s most current, exciting writers will discuss the transformative power of storytelling and its ability to mobilise and enlighten individuals, communities and humanity. As always, the UWRF festival carefully selects its Main Programme speakers, whose works, knowledge and life experiences add poignance, depth and reality into each year’s discussions. A highly-anticipated speaker is Tari Lang , author of the memoir ‘ My Neighbour, The Dictator,’ in which she recounts her life as a fourteen-year-old girl in 1965 when General Suharto’s coup saw her parents imprisoned without trial, and how this history continues to shape who she is.
